definitions.explanation: A person who betrays the trust of others, whether in personal relationships, organizations, or political allegiances. Carries strong negative emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}だ。
⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}がいた。
examples.english: There was a traitor among the group.

examples.japanese: {裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: Even though he was called a traitor, he stuck to his beliefs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り→裏切り：17967_uragiri⟧ (betrayal; the noun form of ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧) and ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (person). A highly emotional word used to label someone who has broken trust. Common in fiction (especially period dramas and thrillers) and in heated interpersonal or political disputes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call someone a traitor
- {裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to forgive a traitor
- {裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search for a traitor

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to betray — the verb form
- ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り→裏切り：17967_uragiri⟧: betrayal — the noun describing the act
- {反逆者|はんぎゃくしゃ}: rebel; insurgent — implies rebellion against authority rather than personal betrayal
- {売国奴|ばいこくど}: traitor to one's country — a much stronger and specifically political term
